conventions.convention: Open chains have L ≥ 2; rings have L ≥ 3 and periodic indices. Absent open-chain boundary currents are zero. The oriented current is j_{j,j+1} = (i/ℏ)[h_{j,j+1},q_{j+1}], giving incoming minus outgoing charge change.
The finite-volume correlation is centered, real and symmetrized, with normalization C_L(t) = L⁻¹ Re ω_{β,L}(J_L°(t)J_L°). No existence or interchange of volume, time or regulator limits is included.

The Mazur bound uses a positive-definite stationary density, centers J_L with that same density, and uses the matrix inner product Tr(ρA*B), linear in its second argument. Its conclusion is unnormalized; H = H_L is required for the lattice-transport specialization.

The classical variance limit assumes a centered, second-order stationary, norm-continuous L²-valued process and absolute improper Riemann integrability of its correlation. Its time integral is a Bochner integral.

The quantum variance limit retains the cited finite-range spin-system hypotheses, Countable Choice and finite-matrix C*-identity, uses an invariant state and centered self-adjoint observable, and assumes Lebesgue L¹ integrability of the real correlation. D is a conditional integrated-observable variance coefficient.

load_bearing.statement: On a nonzero finite-dimensional Hilbert space, self-adjoint nearest-neighbor bond energies and local charges satisfy off-bond commutation and [h_{j,j+1},q_j+q_{j+1}] = 0. Define j_{j,j+1} = (i/ℏ)[h_{j,j+1},q_{j+1}], total current J_L, its Gibbs-centered Heisenberg correlation C_L(t) = L⁻¹ Re ω_{β,L}(J_L°(t)J_L°), and require any transport proposal to specify its normalization, regulators and limit order.
Each bond current is self-adjoint, and with q̇_j = (i/ℏ)[H_L,q_j], the exact identity q̇_j = j_{j-1,j} − j_{j,j+1} holds at every site. Consequently [H_L,Σ_j q_j] = 0.

For the specified centered self-adjoint current J, finite-dimensional self-adjoint H, positive-definite stationary density ρ, and linearly independent conserved matrices Q₁,…,Q_m, let G_ab = Tr(ρQ_a*Q_b) and v_a = Tr(ρQ_a*J). Then G is positive definite and lim_{T→∞} T⁻¹∫₀ᵀ Re ω(α_t(J)J) dt ≥ v*G⁻¹v ≥ 0.
